preconditions.description: The size of the grid is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid has exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in 'SG.' for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains either 'S', 'G', or '.'.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'UNIQUE', 'NONE', or 'MULTIPLE'.
If the output is 'UNIQUE', there are n+1 lines in total.

postconditions.expression: output[0] == 'UNIQUE' implies all(len(row) == n for row in output[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', each of the next n lines has exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: output[0] == 'UNIQUE' implies all(cell in 'SG' for row in output[1:] for cell in row)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', each cell in the next n lines contains either 'S' or 'G'.
If the output is 'NONE', there is exactly one line.
If the output is 'MULTIPLE', there is exactly one line.
